items.title_kr: Counter-hegemony and polycrisis II: movement science and experiments in care
items.original_title: Counter-hegemony and polycrisis II: movement science and experiments in care
summary_points: 연구 배경 및 문제의식: Polycrisis presents as everything, everywhere all at once, the name for a world in which disasters arrive together.

핵심 분석 및 발견: It should mean something more precise: not a coincidence of shocks but the exhaustion of the cheapened nature, money, work, care, food, energy and life on which capitalist accumulation has depended, and the absence of any successor regime able to reconstitute them. 더불어 저자들은 By joining Giovanni Arrighi's theory of hegemonic cycles to world-ecology, it is possible to track how that exhaustion is administered, and contested, through what Gramsci called the integral state: the unity of political and civil society through which a ruling bloc governs.
트윈 연구 시사점: 복합 위기(Polycrisis) 시대에 고립된 개인과 재난 약자가 배제되지 않도록 돕는 무해하고 투과성 높은 공공 위기 대응 인터페이스의 필요성을 뒷받침합니다.

items.title_kr: Extending the MM-AR Metamodeling Platform with Process Mining Capabilities
items.original_title: Extending the MM-AR Metamodeling Platform with Process Mining Capabilities
items.authors: Geraldine Hürzeler, Hans-Georg Fill, Daniel Borcard
summary_points: 연구 배경 및 문제의식: Process mining derives process models from event data recorded by information systems, but its results are usually presented as two-dimensional visualizations that are separate from the environments in which enterprise models are created and maintained.

핵심 분석 및 발견: Metamodeling platforms for extended reality (XR), such as MM-AR, allow users to define modeling languages and to display models in 2D and 3D, but they do not provide access to event data or mining algorithms so far. 더불어 저자들은 In this paper we therefore present a first proof-of-concept for showing how an XR-based metamodeling platform can be extended with process discovery capabilities without changes to the platform core through a separate Python service based on the open source PM4Py process mining library.
트윈 연구 시사점: 기술 시스템을 단순한 기능적 도구가 아닌 권력과 사회적 가치가 각인된 '사회기술시스템(Socio-technical Systems)'으로 바라보며, 플랫폼 독점과 알고리즘 통제에 비판적으로 개입하는 분석적 안목을 확장합니다.

items.title_kr: When Services Matter: Rethinking Farmer Cooperation in an Export-Oriented Smallholder Setting
items.original_title: When Services Matter: Rethinking Farmer Cooperation in an Export-Oriented Smallholder Setting
items.authors: Engjell Skreli, Orjon Xhoxhi, Vladislav Valentinov
summary_points: 연구 배경 및 문제의식: Why does agricultural cooperation remain fragile in post-socialist settings, despite its potential to reduce transaction costs and improve market access? Explanations usually stress institutional voids and the legacy of distrust.

핵심 분석 및 발견: This paper advances a different view: farmers cooperate when the services offered are economically salient. 더불어 저자들은 Adapting Ostrom’s SES framework, we reinterpret “resource importance” for club goods, specifically cooperation services such as marketing, certification, and input procurement.
트윈 연구 시사점: 자본주의적 산업 농업과 추출주의적 대지 착취를 비판하고, 흙·미생물·농민의 자치 역량이 상호 얽혀 회복력을 발휘하는 농생태학(Agroecology) 및 대지 윤리적 실천에 긴밀히 연결됩니다.

items.title_kr: Toward Making Power More Explicit in the IADF: A Review and Diagnostic Approach to Power Theories
items.original_title: Toward Making Power More Explicit in the IADF: A Review and Diagnostic Approach to Power Theories
items.authors: IASC-ECN Power Collective, Désirée Schwindenhammer, Lavanya Suresh
summary_points: 연구 배경 및 문제의식: In commons and institutional research, the Institutional Analysis and Development framework (IADF) has proven itself as a useful tool to investigate the complexities of social-environmental systems.

핵심 분석 및 발견: It is effective in guiding researchers through the process of understanding complex problem situations. 더불어 저자들은 The framework helps to conceptually unravel the institutional scaffoldings structuring human-nature interactions.
트윈 연구 시사점: 기술 관료주의적 하향식 시스템을 넘어 시민과 취약계층이 스스로의 경험과 권리를 능동적으로 행사할 수 있는 참여적 사용자 인터페이스(Civic Interface) 및 포용적 공공데이터 안전망 설계에 직접적으로 적용될 수 있습니다.

items.title_kr: Sons or seeds: gender, care work, and agrobiodiversity in translocal households of rural China
items.original_title: Sons or seeds: gender, care work, and agrobiodiversity in translocal households of rural China
summary_points: 연구 배경 및 문제의식: Abstract Drawing on fieldwork in two remote mountainous villages in northern and southwestern China, this paper examines women’s (re)engagement with seed keeping practices and agroecological production with the support of social organizations.

핵심 분석 및 발견: We foreground the dilemma between caring for sons and caring for seeds faced by so-called ‘left-behind’ women in translocal households. 더불어 저자들은 Women’s care work for seeds sustains local agrobiodiversity and contributes to their family’s access to healthy food.
트윈 연구 시사점: 도시 공간의 상품화와 젠트리피케이션에 맞서 모든 시민이 공간에 대한 권리(Right to the City)를 누릴 수 있는 도시 커먼즈의 물리적·사회적 인프라 전략에 시사점을 던집니다.

items.title_kr: Platform Content Moderation and Freedom of Expression in Southeast Asia: A Systematic Literature Review
items.original_title: Platform Content Moderation and Freedom of Expression in Southeast Asia: A Systematic Literature Review
items.authors: NIZAR AL-GHIFARY, Muliana Muliana, Krisna Puspita
summary_points: 연구 배경 및 문제의식: Background Big Tech platform self-regulation and national anti-disinformation laws jointly govern political speech in Southeast Asia, a region without a supranational regulatory framework, yet their interaction has not been systematically synthesized.

핵심 분석 및 발견: This review examined how they interact in shaping political disinformation and freedom of expression in the region from 2015 to 2025. 더불어 저자들은 Methods Following PRISMA 2020, we searched Scopus, ScienceDirect, SAGE Journals, and JSTOR in April–May 2026 for English-language, peer-reviewed studies.
트윈 연구 시사점: 기술 시스템을 단순한 기능적 도구가 아닌 권력과 사회적 가치가 각인된 '사회기술시스템(Socio-technical Systems)'으로 바라보며, 플랫폼 독점과 알고리즘 통제에 비판적으로 개입하는 분석적 안목을 확장합니다.

items.title_kr: From people to crops: unpacking displacement for the expansion of commodity agriculture
items.original_title: From people to crops: unpacking displacement for the expansion of commodity agriculture
items.authors: Olivia del Giorgio, Carla Gras, Lorenzo Langbehn
summary_points: 연구 배경 및 문제의식: Commodity agriculture is rapidly expanding worldwide, often at the expense of natural environments and smallholder agricultural systems.

핵심 분석 및 발견: In this paper, we unpack the process of smallholder displacement due to the expansion of agricultural commodity frontiers in the Argentine Chaco, where large-scale soy and cattle operations are advancing over forests used by small-scale herders. 더불어 저자들은 We identify a series of trends related to the agricultural frontier – growing pressures on local livelihoods, changing mobility patterns, shifting strategies of land control, and weakening of organized resistance – that conspire to create unstable conditions for families.
트윈 연구 시사점: 자본주의적 산업 농업과 추출주의적 대지 착취를 비판하고, 흙·미생물·농민의 자치 역량이 상호 얽혀 회복력을 발휘하는 농생태학(Agroecology) 및 대지 윤리적 실천에 긴밀히 연결됩니다.
